newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - June 17.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - China's state banks started state debt spot and repurchase trading on Monday on the Shanghai-based local currency interbank market, with the first day's turnover hitting 1.1 billion yuan.

- Chinese financial institutions have responded positively to Beijing's recent punishment of some leading listed firms and brokerages, saying the move is an important step towards standardising the financial markets.
- BUSINESS NEWS - China's fledging petrochemical market has been hit by cheap imports and experts urged the state to take appropriate measures to protect the domestic industry.
- A commentary urges Beijing to take measures to halt the heavy inflow of foreign retail firms.
